page_title: HOF 3-1 HEI | Hoffenheim v Heidenheim 25/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Matthias Jollenbeck is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Hoffenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+2' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play. Hoffenheim will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+1' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The attendance is 24000.
89' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
88' Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) hits the crossbar with a rebound from near the penalty spot.
87' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Oliver Baumann was alert and made a comfortable save.
86' Shots on target – 6:3.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) is coming onto the pitch as Andrej Kramaric cannot continue after picking up an injury.
83' Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul after Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
82' Heidenheim concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
80' The resulting corner from Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
80' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
78' Substitution. Omar Haktab Traore walks off the pitch and Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) comes on as a substitute.
78' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Heidenheim is cautioned for aggressive play.
76' Christian Ilzer has decided to substitute Fisnik Asllani and he is replaced by Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim).
76' Substitution. Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) on for Tim Lemperle.
75' 3 - 1 Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a precise shot inside the right post. What a lovely finish!
73' Hoffenheim quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
72' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing.
72' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) inside the box. The linesman makes the right call and Heidenheim will have a corner.
70' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Adrian Beck will be replaced by Marnon Busch (Heidenheim).
67' Christian Ilzer prepares a substitution. Bazoumana Toure is replaced by Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim).
67' Substitution. Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Wouter Burger walks off.
63' 3 - 0 Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) collects a sweet pass inside the penalty box and smashes the ball inside the left post. What a clinical finish!
60' Heidenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' The foul by Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Matthias Jollenbeck.

54' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the right post.
54' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
53' Heidenheim take a short corner kick.
51' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
50' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) commits a rough challenge and Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle for a foul.
49' A lofted cross from Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
48' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

48' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball is out of play and Hoffenheim manage to earn a corner.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Frank Schmidt probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Benedikt Gimber. He is replaced by Julian Niehues (Heidenheim).
46' Frank Schmidt has made a change at the break. Stefan Schimmer has come on in place of Budu Zivzivadze (Heidenheim).
46' Half-time substitution. Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) is replaced by Mathias Honsak.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Matthias Jollenbeck has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' 2 - 0 Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) latches on to a precise pass inside the box and drills in a superb strike that finds its way into the middle of the net.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' A player from Hoffenheim brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
44' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) gets in a header from close range after a lofted pass, but the effort flies just over the bar.
41' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) produces a shot from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His effort sails narrowly over the crossbar. The goalkeeper was lucky there.
39' The referee blows his whistle as Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) was too aggressive in his challenge. Hoffenheim win a free kick.
37' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
35' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) tackles a bit over-zealously and Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul.
34' A pass from Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) is intercepted by Diant Ramaj and the move breaks down.
33' A player from Hoffenheim commits a rough challenge. Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
32' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
30' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes the corner which is cleared.
29' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Corner kick. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity.
25' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) commits a foul and Matthias Jollenbeck immediately signals a free kick.
25' Hoffenheim are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
21' A pass by Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
18' 1 - 0 Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) collects a good pass and slams the ball from mid-range into the top right corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
15' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) makes a slide tackle, but referee Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul.
13' A cross into the box from Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) is cleared. Heidenheim earn a corner.
10' Hoffenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
3' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Matthias Jollenbeck blows for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Hoffenheim will have the kick-off.
Matthias Jollenbeck is introduced as the referee for today's match.
